title: oxalis corniculata var. villosa
intro: Oxalis corniculata var. villosa, commonly known as a hairy wood sorrel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Oxalidaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and kidney stones, due to its health benefits such as diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of hairy wood sorrel include alleviating symptoms of arthritis, gout, and kidney stones, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and oxalic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
